evals.prompt: Backtest, validate, preview, and deploy a Loki Ruler alerting rule group `otel-checkout-log-alerts` in namespace `otel-demo` for tenant `otel-demo` that pages Alertmanager (`OtelCheckoutLogErrorRatioHigh`, `severity: critical`) when `checkout-service` JSON `PlaceOrder` error logs (`status >= 500` during `paymentFailure`) exceed `5%` of total logs over `[5m]` for `5m` (firing only when at least `25` error/log events occur in `5m`).
evals.expected_output: Reads `loki://rules/groups`, backtests the LogQL expression via `loki_query_instant` and `loki_query_range` (`1h–6h`), validates rule structure via `scripts/validate_loki_rules.py` (`for: 5m`, `(denominator > 0)` divide-by-zero guard + `>= 25` event floor, `severity: critical`, `service_name: checkout-service`, `summary`/`description`/`runbook_url` annotations), calls `loki_upsert_rule_group(namespace="otel-demo", group_name="otel-checkout-log-alerts", rules_yaml=..., dry_run=True, org_id="otel-demo")` to inspect the unified diff, and applies with `dry_run=False, confirm=True`.
expectations: Backtests the `checkout-service` LogQL alerting expression via `loki_query_instant` and `loki_query_range` and validates locally via `validate_loki_rules.py` before deployment
Protects the error ratio against divide-by-zero (`> 0` denominator guard) and includes a `>= 25` minimum event floor plus `for: 5m`
Calls `loki_upsert_rule_group` chronologically with `dry_run=True` first, followed by `dry_run=False, confirm=True` scoped to `org_id="otel-demo"`

evals.prompt:
Review and deploy this `otel-demo` Loki recording rule to Ruler:
```yaml
name: otel-session-errors
interval: 1m
rules:
  - record: loki_errors_total
    expr: sum by (session_id, trace_id, pod_ip) (rate({namespace="otel-demo"} |= "error" | json [5m]))
```
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/validate_loki_rules.py` and refuses to deploy the broken rule: (1) `by (session_id, trace_id, pod_ip)` aggregates by high-cardinality dimensions emitted by `load-generator` / `frontend-proxy` that will explode `observability` Prometheus remote-write TSDB series, and (2) `record: loki_errors_total` violates `level:metric:operations` colon naming. Rewrites to `namespace_service:loki_errors:rate5m` aggregated `by (namespace, service_name)` and validates the safe replacement.
expectations: Runs `validate_loki_rules.py` and refuses deploying `by (session_id, trace_id, pod_ip)` due to remote-write Prometheus TSDB cardinality explosion
Flags `loki_errors_total` for violating `level:metric:operations` recording rule naming
Provides a validated `by (namespace, service_name)` replacement rule without pushing the unsafe rule to Ruler

Includes `for: 5m` (`>= 2m`) to prevent false pages during `helm upgrade` rolling restarts
Validates via `validate_loki_rules.py` with `severity` label and `summary`/`description` annotations without deploying live
